env.description: Environment values for the integration's child commands. Bind declared secrets here, never into command text or runner arguments. A declared plaintext object or array explicitly mapped here is encoded as compact JSON; strings are unchanged.

runner.description: Executable and fixed arguments used for every command on this integration. The command text is appended as one final argument, without interpolation. Stdin, output capture, and exit handling are unchanged. Relative executable paths use the host-supplied working directory. Defaults to /bin/bash -c.
